-- One row of health numbers for the daily message. No question text, no names.
-- Error flow (design part 11, generated by build_ops_workflows.daily_health): real answers checked, unresolved
-- incidents, the latest eval run per set and the latest backup, for the four lines under "Questions". Internal sessions
-- (canary, evals, deploy checks: is_internal_session) are neither people nor answers. Still no question text and no
-- names: counts, and workflow and node names as the alerts show them.
with qa as (        -- real answers of the last 24 h: Layer 1 writes the row before sending, the grader adds the verdict
  select count(*)                                                                   as answers_24h,
         count(*) filter (where verdict = 'grounded')                               as grounded_24h,
         count(*) filter (where verdict = 'partial')                                as partial_24h,
         count(*) filter (where verdict = 'unsupported')                            as unsupported_24h,
         count(*) filter (where verdict = 'not_applicable')                         as not_applicable_24h,
         count(*) filter (where verdict is null or verdict = 'not_graded')          as not_graded_24h,
         -- the user saw a "Could not verify" footer: any flag except tool_unavailable (a line of its own) and
         -- check_failed (never shown)
         count(*) filter (where exists (
           select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(flags) = 'array' then flags else '[]' end) f
            where coalesce(f->>'code', '') not in ('tool_unavailable', 'check_failed'))) as flagged_24h,
         exists (select 1 from qa_check where not is_internal_session(session_id))  as answers_ever
    from qa_check
   where at > now() - interval '24 hours' and not is_internal_session(session_id)
),
inc as (            -- unresolved incidents of the last 24 h, labelled as the alerts label them (kind ok = a success record)
  select id, at, source, workflow, node, kind, notified_at,
         coalesce(nullif(regexp_replace(coalesce(workflow, ''), '^RAG\s*[–-]\s*', ''), ''),
                  case source when 'chat_agent' then 'Chat agent' when 'look_at_pages' then 'Look at pages'
                              when 'pipe' then 'Open WebUI pipe' when 'watch' then 'Watch' when 'backup' then 'Backup'
                              when 'eval' then 'Evals' else coalesce(source, 'unknown') end) as label
    from incident_log
   where at > now() - interval '24 hours' and resolved_at is null and kind is distinct from 'ok'
),
incidents as (
  select (select count(*) from inc)                                                 as incidents_24h,
         (select string_agg(label || ' ' || n, ', ' order by n desc, label)
            from (select label, count(*) as n from inc group by label order by n desc, label limit 3) t) as incidents_by_workflow,
         (select json_build_object('at', at, 'label', label, 'node', node) from inc order by at desc, id desc limit 1)
                                                                                    as last_incident,
         -- throttled rows nobody heard about (R32, R34): not alerted themselves, and no "+N more" counted them (only a
         -- same-key alert within 30 min after the row does). A row younger than 30 min may still be counted.
         (select count(*) from inc r
           where r.notified_at is null and r.at <= now() - interval '30 minutes'
             and not exists (select 1 from incident_log l
                              where l.source = r.source and l.workflow is not distinct from r.workflow
                                and l.node is not distinct from r.node and l.kind is not distinct from r.kind
                                and l.notified_at is not null and l.at > r.at and l.at <= r.at + interval '30 minutes'))
                                                                                    as incidents_not_alerted
),
ev as (             -- the latest run of each eval set
  select distinct on (set_name) set_name, passed, total, at from eval_run order by set_name, at desc, id desc
),
evals as (
  select (select json_build_object('passed', passed, 'total', total, 'at', at) from ev where set_name = 'demo') as eval_demo,
         (select json_build_object('passed', passed, 'total', total, 'at', at) from ev where set_name = 'messy') as eval_messy,
         (select json_build_object('passed', passed, 'total', total, 'at', at) from ev where set_name = 'visual') as eval_visual
),
bk as (             -- the latest good backup: ops/backup.sh posts kind ok with data {bytes, path}, only bytes is read
  select at, data from incident_log where source = 'backup' and kind = 'ok' order by at desc, id desc limit 1
),
backup as (
  select (select at from bk)                                                        as backup_at,
         (select case when jsonb_typeof(data->'bytes') = 'number' then (data->>'bytes')::numeric end from bk)
                                                                                    as backup_bytes,
         (select round((extract(epoch from now() - at) / 3600)::numeric, 1) from bk) as backup_age_h,
         -- sets on disk: one per good run, and the script keeps the newest 14
         (select least(count(*), 14) from incident_log where source = 'backup' and kind = 'ok') as backup_sets
)
select
  (select count(distinct metadata->>'file_id') from documents)                      as files_searchable,
  (select count(*) from documents)                                                  as passages,
  (select count(*) from storage.objects where bucket_id = 'document-images')        as images,
  (select count(distinct file_id) from document_rows)                               as sheets,
  (select count(*) from ingestion_log where logged_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
      and step in ('vector_write', 'rows_write'))                                   as ingested_24h,
  -- a file counts as failing only if its LATEST log entry is a failure (later successes clear it)
  (select count(*) from (select distinct on (file_id) status from ingestion_log where file_id is not null
                         order by file_id, id desc) l where l.status = 'failed')   as failing_now,
  (select count(*) from (select distinct on (file_id) status from ingestion_log where file_id is not null
                         order by file_id, id desc) l where l.status = 'retry')    as retrying_now,
  (select count(*) from ingestion_log where logged_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
      and status = 'skipped')                                                        as skipped_24h,
  (select string_agg(left(coalesce(file_name, '?'), 45) || ': ' || left(coalesce(message, ''), 70), E'\n')
     from (select * from (select distinct on (file_id) file_name, message, status from ingestion_log
                           where file_id is not null order by file_id, id desc) l
            where l.status = 'failed' limit 5) f)                                   as failures,
  (select count(*) from usage_log where asked_at > now() - interval '24 hours' and not internal)    as questions_24h,
  (select count(distinct user_hash) from usage_log where asked_at > now() - interval '24 hours' and not internal) as people_24h,
  (select count(*) from usage_log where asked_at > now() - interval '7 days' and not internal)      as questions_7d,
  (select count(distinct user_hash) from usage_log where asked_at > now() - interval '7 days' and not internal)   as people_7d,
  (select count(*) from privacy_log where at > now() - interval '24 hours')        as erasures_24h,
  qa.*, incidents.*, evals.*, backup.*
from qa, incidents, evals, backup;

## RAG – Daily health (8:00 every morning)
Counts what matters from Supabase — documents searchable, last-24-hour ingestion, files **still** failing, questions and active people — and sends one Telegram message. No question text, no names.

**Error flow** (generated by build_ops_workflows.py): **Answers** checked by the grader, unresolved **Incidents**, the latest **Evals** run per set (⚠️ below its floor) and the latest **Backup** (⚠️ after 36 h without one). Internal sessions (canary, evals) count as neither people nor answers.

Use **Manual test** to send one now.
